resources.string: While this time block is active, FocusGuard protects itself from uninstall on Device Owner devices. You can revoke the entire block early by entering your master password.
Protected time blocking needs Device Owner so Android can apply the package-scoped uninstall guard. Configure Device Owner before activating this block.
Enter your master password to end this time block early. This also releases its uninstall protection when no other protected time block remains.
The time block could not be revoked.
